parent_principle: Both items were required by earlier q_rec planning but were never numerically instantiated. They are completed here, prospectively, before the first target-dependent operation of the pipeline.

S_PERS.name: persistence skill

zero_denominator_behaviour.note: no epsilon, no floor, no substitution

S_PERS.discharge_level_definition: S_pers(M,s) = 1 - mean_b MSE(M,s,b) / mean_b MSE(B1,s,b), provided the denominator is nonzero
S_PERS.V3_mandatory_gate: remains exactly the already-frozen paired NRMSE condition, unchanged

B1A_AR1.name: simple first-order autoregressive comparator
B1A_AR1.added_to_V3_note: not added unless a frozen parent already requires it; no frozen parent does
B1A_AR1.calibration_fit: y_k = a + phi * y_{k-1} + eps_k, ordinary least squares on the calibration interval
protected_block_procedure: initialise with the FINAL CALIBRATION target value
NEVER update the recursion using protected target values
a and phi remain calibration-fitted and frozen over that block
B1A_AR1.belongs_to: S7.9 / S7.10, alongside B0-B3 and H0_RAW_HARDENED
